subject: pe
title: Cool-Down: Why & How
welcome_lead: Don't just stop — ease your body back to normal.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: gentle jog, static stretches, recovery.

concepts.def: Slow jog to lower the heart rate.
Drink fluids to replace what's lost.

walkthroughs.body_html: End with a gentle jog or walk. Heart rate drops gradually. Stopping suddenly can make you dizzy.
Hold key muscle stretches for 20-30 seconds. Targets the big movers — quads, hamstrings, calves, shoulders.
Hydrate and eat a small mix of carbs and protein. Sleep well to repair muscles.
